basic_info.description: This modern, elevator move-in-ready enclosed 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom loft condo offers a functional and stylish living space with high ceilings and an airy, open atmosphere. The kitchen faces a large window, filling the home with natural light all day long. Located in a boutique 19-unit elevator building (built in 2001), this residence provides convenience and privacy, with separate-level bedrooms for added comfort. Parking includes an assigned spot with extra storage space in front, and you can easily access your unit via stairs or elevator. A shared courtyard offers a place to relax, while a private hallway leads directly to your door.    Situated at 155 Harriet Street, just steps from Folsom Street's vibrant restaurants, bars, and coffee shops, this home is perfect for those who love urban convenience. The bike-friendly area ensures an easy commute, and the neighborhood is set to become even more desirable with the upcoming Gene Friend Recreation Center Park (opening mid-2026), featuring a gymnasium, basketball courts, playgrounds, and modern exercise facilities right across the street (per SFrecpark.org). Don't miss outown your ideal urban retreat today!
